NPA TYPES (per trio-shared SNP; parental_alleles = father UNION mother; nonparental = child - parental):
 - DOUBLE (DOCHAN): BOTH child alleles absent from both parents (F=AA,M=GG,child=CT) = the flagship 16kb biallelic haplotype-substitution signal.
 - SINGLE (SINPA/HETEROPOP): one child allele absent, child het (F=AA,M=AA,child=AG).
 - LOSS-OF-HET (HOMOPOP): child HOMOZYGOUS for an allele parents can't both supply (F=AA,M=AG,child=GG); X-chrom excluded (male hemizygosity = false HOMOPOPs).
 NPA = DOUBLE + SINGLE. Cluster into 'mislands' via sliding window (60-SNP/20-step, >=5/window) -> collapse.

THE KEY PRINCIPLE (why our chr22 pilot broke): all old work ran on CALLED GENOTYPES, whose dominant false-positive is ALLELIC DROPOUT in a parent - parent truly HAS the allele but the call missed it (true het read as hom) -> fake non-parental. Genotype/chip data CANNOT see or filter this. HONEST: the old pipeline had NO MAF filter, NO normalization (indels excluded not normalized), NO depth/dropout QC, weak trio validation. So we're DESIGNING the rigorous version, not recovering it.

THE FIX (30x reads): stop trusting calls, INTERROGATE THE PILEUP. For each candidate NPA, pull the PARENTS' actual reads at that coord; if the child's 'non-parental' allele appears in either parent's reads at all -> INHERITED, dropout artifact, KILL. Only zero-parental-support sites survive. Confirm child from reads (DOUBLE = child VAF~1.0, parents absent). Then cluster survivors = read-validated mislands.
